fact: Kwara State launched its KW-GIS-based digital land information system, and the KW-IRS chairman says investors and titleholders can now register land, process CofO and obtain building approvals online.
The KW-GIS project manager lists digital parcel mapping and querying and land records integration among the platform's features.
The KW-IRS chairman says the KW-IRS online payment platform is integrated with the new land system, so land and related payments are made online.
The Housing and Urban Development Minister said on 16 July 2026 that the ministry is advancing electronic land records and a Centralised Lands Repository Management System to cut processing time.
Nugi Technologies says Cross River State's 360Lands digital registry has processed 330 applications, 188 Certificates of Occupancy and 142 consent applications, since implementation.

Nugi Technologies says 360Lands integrates the state Ministry of Lands, the Geographic Information Agency, the Surveyor General's Office and Physical Planning, with parcels viewable on satellite maps through a GIS.
BusinessDay reports Lagos State launched its e-GIS portal in January 2024, through which land title applications moved from paper to digital processing.
BusinessDay says Lagos's e-GIS merged archived land records with land titles and holds transaction history for every parcel in the state's cadastre, with surveys requestable on it.
